svg.title: INTACT project statement and community invitation
svg.desc: A strong representation keeps important information intact. INTACT turns LeWM into a stronger world model. Issues, pull requests, and community participation are welcome.

g.text: A strong representation keeps the information that matters intact.
强大的信息传递机制能够确保重要信息不被遗漏。
INTACT does exactly that, turning LeWM into a stronger world model.
INTACT 正是实现了这一目标，将 LeWM 提升为一个更强大的世界模型。
Issues and pull requests are welcome. Join our community!
欢迎大家提交 Issue、PR，并加入我们的 Community！
